scope.summary: Implement duplicate alert suppression for POST /api/alerts using configurable window minutes, returning 200 with suppression header for duplicates and 201 for newly created alerts.
scope_anchors: POST /api/alerts status/header branching for duplicate suppression result
Duplicate detection in alert create path using title case-insensitive + severity + active + created within configurable window

constraints: Duplicate match requires same title (case-insensitive) and same severity.
Duplicate candidate must be within configured suppression window minutes.
Duplicate response must be 200 OK with header X-Duplicate-Suppressed: true and existing alert payload.
Suppression window must be configuration-driven via appsettings.json.

deterministic_prepass.smallest_concrete_scope: controller + service duplicate decision path + configuration wiring + integration/service tests
